title: Actual stopped Gaussian RGO output accuracy
source_anchor: arXiv:2609.06906v1 Theorem6.5 A1 finite recursive error propagation, equations(6.5) and following induction
target_statement: In the normalized baseline-smoothness-one setting, with actual finite dimension d>0, kappa>=1,0<c<1/4, measurable history-dependent eta in (0,c],0<Delta<=1/2,0<gamma<=1,C>=8 and q=2, compute B,J once from s0 using the source formulas. Set beta(s)=1+b(s), K(b)=(1+b)/(kappa^-1+b), and source tau=K when K>=2 else c. Instantiate GaussianRGOErrorBudget with kappa(s)=K(b(s)), supplied actual smoothed-output M satisfying its continuing-state source W2 accuracy and arbitrary Markov terminal L. Construct actual T,H,F,Q,P,R. Invoke StoppedRGODepth with this same Q,L, prove F and P witnesses equal via all explicit coordinates and threshold coercions, and derive R_n=L composed with P^n from recursion. Obtain actual terminal support mass one at J and output stability at s0 for every J+m. Bound KL(R_J(s0)||T(s0)) by J*Delta²/(J+1) plus the terminal-set integral of KL(L||T) under P^J(s0), without terminal accuracy assumptions. If terminal KL<=Delta²/(J+1) holds only on that fixed terminal set, conclude KL(R_(J+m)(s0)||T(s0))<=Delta² for every m. Do not substitute J+m into the general linear budget.

source_detail_audit.gap: Actual Gaussian error program must be identified with the source stopped program, and its terminal support used to control residual.

source_detail_audit.fidelity_boundary: This is stopped-output correctness under supplied A1 and terminal KL interfaces. It does not prove Picard or FORS implements them, identify curvature of arbitrary probability mu, validate reference points or initial histories, or bound expected queries. Source scalar schedule is normalized to baseline smoothness one. C>=8 is a sufficient proved constant, gamma range is for depth rather than FORS sufficiency. Threshold and J are initial-state fixed; full-kernel equality at a universal J is not claimed. Actual same-program witness alignment and terminal support must be proved, not assumed.

conceptual_mirror_audit.reason: An actual-program consumer of the established KL chain mechanism, not a new conceptual equivalence.
